scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional quantum instrument calculation, complemented by bounded numerical path enumeration; prior operator family and central limit theorem are attributed to Dhahri et al.; numerical checks are not proofs for every time or lag.
scientific_limitations: Squared-step stationary lag law requires initial internal state I/2; state-dependent signed transport formula is for arbitrary qubit preparations. No extension to different OQRW instruments; independent audit and global novelty certification have not been performed.
title: Exact two-mode volatility clustering in a noncommuting open quantum walk
